subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

She _______ the target by an inch and lost the gold medal. [hit]
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hit"** means to reach or achieve a target or goal. (लक्ष्य पर पहुंचना)
 
 
• **Example: **She hit the bullseye with her first arrow.
 
 
 
• **"Missed"** refers to failing to reach or achieve a target or goal. (चूकना)
 
 
• **Example: **He missed the deadline for submitting his assignment.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'hit'** is **'missed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Touched **(छुआ): To come into contact with something.
 
 
• **Example:** She touched the surface to feel its texture.
 
 
 
• **Bashed **(पीटा ): To strike something with force.
 
 
• **Example: **He bashed the piñata until it broke open.
 
 
 
• **Cleaned** (साफ किया): To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something.
 
 
• **Example:** She cleaned the kitchen thoroughly after dinner.

The correct answer is: **Option 4**
